subject: doc
title: DOC.------(R)INFO.TRNS.
description: Diagram in WAC-27, the second on book p229. (C)DOC — the *concept* of documentation — is crossed with (R)INFO-TRNS — the *reality* of information transference. The (c) on documentation and the (r) on information-transference are deliberately paired: Braxton is asking what the concept of documentation actually does to the reality of information transference. DOC outputs to PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), INFO-TRNS (the crossing), and POL-DYM (political dynamics). POL-DYM branches to MT-INFO (multi-information), which carries two chains: SOC-RT (social reality) → GRAD (gradualism), and AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) → EXT-FT (extended functionalism) → PR-TRS → (R)MPT (the reality of manipulation). Structural argument: the concept of documentation reaches multi-information and social reality only via political dynamics.
